ranked_facts.concept_key: unilateral purulent nasal discharge with blood
ranked_facts.why: The presence of unilateral purulent discharge mixed with blood is more indicative of an infectious process, such as bacterial sinusitis, which is a leaf exemplar of candidate B1, than of an inflammatory or neoplastic process.

ranked_facts.concept_key: new symptoms of nasal discharge with worsening pain
ranked_facts.why: The development of new symptoms such as nasal discharge with worsening pain after initial treatment for acute sinusitis suggests a complication or progression of the infectious process, which is more consistent with candidate B1 than with an anatomical obstruction or a neoplastic process.
